variant.author: BlueWaveXIV
variant.changelog:
Pricing safety: Free Market Price requires confirmed absence of eligible competitors. Full available market results, HQ/NQ matching and own-retainer ID filtering improve AutoList and AutoRefresh; unsafe read failures cannot use cached prices.
Workflow safety: conflicting runs are blocked, listing submissions and confirmations are verified, comparison requests are throttled and bounded, and AutoTidy can restore more than 20 matching listings across target retainers.
Withdrawal: matching partial-stack capacity, deferred retries, accurate partial-transfer logs and explicit stalled-state reporting.
96 automated regression checks pass. Released for in-game testing; native smoke tests remain pending.

variant.author: BlueWaveXIV
variant.changelog:
Faster AutoRefresh: retainers whose main-list sale count confirms zero items are skipped without opening their menus or sell lists. Counts are checked live on each retainer switch; unavailable counts still use normal inspection.
Skip messages appear in the copyable Action Log without inflating skipped-item totals. Pricing checks, quote caching and own-retainer exclusion are unchanged.
All 197 automated checks pass. Released for in-game testing; native empty-retainer skipping validation remains pending.
